name: Grid Tactics
hook: Tanks, infantry, artillery. Capture their HQ.
how: Take turns moving your units across forests, mountains and roads, then fire. Infantry capture cities for more gold each turn; spend it at your bases on new units. Capture the enemy HQ or wipe out their army to win. Alone? A bot commander takes the other side.
controls: Click or tap a unit, then a blue tile to drive or a red one to fire; tap your base to build
uses: The host's browser checks every move and plays the bot commander; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot commander plays the other side when you're alone, and a friend who joins takes over from it.
Both players and anyone watching see the same battle; it carries on if someone reloads while another player stays.
Most wins, shown after every battle.
ideas: Add a helicopter that flies over rivers and mountains
Draw a bigger map with a sea in the middle
